allegation_summary: STG-29 SEG 66–70 (232.78s–253.61s): after promising the document (SEG 41–42), [[SPK-diego-latam-supervisor]] reverses and says 'ni siquiera corresponde que yo le entregue una carta', followed by 'si no se calma, la idea es que nos ayudemos'. Conditioning the delivery of a statutory notice (LPDC Art. 23 bis / CACH Art. 133) on the passenger's demeanour is moral/psychological coercion: it compels the passenger to refrain from exercising the lawful right to protest and to demand documentation. The conduct meets CPCL Art. 494.16 ('impedir a otro con violencia hacer lo que la ley no prohibe') and is reinforced as apremio ilegitimo under CONST Art. 19.1.
evidentiary_strength: Single contiguous on-tape sequence with three quotes.

legal_basis.article_name: Codigo Penal de Chile, Art. 494 N°16 — Coaccion / Apremio
legal_basis.applicability_rationale: Threatening to withhold a statutory denied-boarding notice unless the passenger 'se calma' compels him to refrain from exercising the lawful right to protest and demand documentation, satisfying Art. 494.16 ('impedir a otro con violencia hacer lo que la ley no prohibe'). The conduct is reinforced as apremio ilegitimo under CONST Art. 19.1. | legacy paraphrase: Sufriran la pena de multa de una a cuatro unidades tributarias mensuales: 16. El que sin estar legitimamente autorizado impidiere a otro con violencia hacer lo que la ley no prohibe, o le compeliere a ejecutar lo que no quiera.

legal_reasoning:
**Applicable Framework**: CPCL Art. 494.16 + CONST Art. 19.1 + LPDC Art. 3(b) / Art. 23 bis.

**Factual Subsumption**: STG-29 SEG 66–70 records [[SPK-diego-latam-supervisor]]'s reversal from 'we'll give you a document' to 'ni siquiera corresponde' and 'si no se calma, la idea es que nos ayudemos.'

**Nexus Fact Norm**: Conditional statutory delivery is moral coercion.

**Evidentiary Strength**: Single contiguous on-tape sequence with three quotes.

**Severity Assessment**: CRITICAL.

**Procedural Integrity**: Compliant with Ontology Invariant I-1.

candidate_articles.preliminary_view: The supervisor's threat to withhold a statutory denied-boarding notice unless the passenger 'se calma' arguably constrains the passenger to refrain from lawful protest—an 'acto' under Art. 13 prohibited if compelled by threats. candidate_articles.preliminary_view: If the passenger suffered moral or material damage from the coercive threat, Art. 2314 could serve as the primary indemnification hook. The provision's generality makes it almost always a fallback, but care must be taken to link the threat directly to a legally cognizable harm.
